Downtown: wind, capsules and dunes

Three established tower forms above a family of shaded podium streets. Architecture uses colour and form without printed lettering. Page labels are technical design notation.

Podium load paths and human scale

A podium section with a continuous core, substantial aligned piers and transfer girders, beside the exported game hero. The front enclosure and half the podium slab are cut away to expose the supports. The browser illustrates the scheduled sections; use the game’s shared SuperEgg functions for production meshes.

This is the P6 planning model, not a game build. Wind gaps, capsule garden and base colonnades are genuine model voids. Collision, controller routes, lift operation and streaming require the implementation diagnostic. Public levels and full parts/joins are below.
